_readme: Edit `tries` with the number of generations each image REALLY took (every retry or edit round counts), then run: node tools/build-images-json.mjs

assumptions.meaning: wh = whPerGeneration x tries. Estimates, not measurements (providers do not publish per-image energy). Style does not change the energy of ONE generation much; it changes how many tries you need. Water in the game = wh x 1 ml (x4 with the power-generation toggle).

images.prompt: a portrait of an old sailor with a white beard, minimalist line art, a single continuous line, lots of white space
images.note: A single line and empty space: almost always right on the first try.

images.prompt: a portrait of an old sailor with a white beard, comic book style with bold outlines and halftone shading
images.note: Bold outlines hide small flaws, so it needs few tries.

images.prompt: a portrait of an old sailor with a white beard, hand-painted anime film style, soft pastel watercolor backgrounds, gentle light
images.note: Soft painted looks forgive small errors, but a retry is usual.

images.prompt: a portrait of an old sailor with a white beard, photorealistic, ultra-detailed, natural lighting
images.note: Photorealism shows every flaw (faces, hands, crowds), so it takes more retries.
